inspector.title: Cortical and white-matter source-label contacts
inspector.caption: Inspect the exact shared cell faces between source white-matter and cortical parcel labels. All 77 source pairs and 31 opposite-side-named contacts are retained for review. These categorical contacts do not establish biological grey–white boundary accuracy, cortical thickness, dysplasia or patient-specific anatomy. Use the separate native SPL MRI reader to inspect the source images.

Publisher-listed additional contributors: Ilwoo Lyu and Martin Styner (Sulcal Curves); Samira Farough (Ventricular System); Ibraheem Naeem and Maria Naeem (Head and Neck Muscles); George Papadimitriou (Cerebellar Parcellation); Madiha Tahir (White Matter). The original source README, including funding acknowledgements and citation instructions, accompanies this package as SOURCE-README.md.

Modified transport and derived visualization version by Primer, 2026-10-16. Exact categorical label-boundary meshes are newly derived from every exposed original label voxel-cell face; they are not original publisher VTK files. No components, cavities, or faces are deleted. The original publisher VTK models are separately retained for comparison.
Conversion: native MRI/label sample bytes are unchanged; original NRRD gzip bodies and headers permit exact source-file reconstruction. VTK coordinate/normal/strip bits are retained; triangle strips are expanded without deleting any implied triangle. Display colors follow the original lookup table. No MRI resampling, coordinate fitting, smoothing, capping, merging or anatomical repair is applied.
This single source case and its processed anatomical labels/surfaces do not establish normal populations, pathology, current-patient registration, complete fine anatomy or clinical approval. The source license states that clinical applications are neither recommended nor advised. No source institution endorsement is implied.

Additional marked adaptation: exact shared voxel-cell faces between source white-matter classes 2/41 and the source cortical parcel classes. No smoothing or gap bridging. These categorical interfaces are not validated biological boundaries, cortical-thickness measurements or patient-specific anatomy. Opposite-side-named source contacts are retained for review.
